description: Set up the deterministic release gate from the application model. action `inspect` (default) renders the target-aware GitHub workflow and CI manifest without writing; `install` writes both with collision protection; `baseline` imports a successful conclusive gate report as the target's baseline. The gate itself runs with `npx -y @aarwitz/tapp@latest ci`. No network, commits, or AI.

actionRef.description: GitHub Action reference owner/repo@tag; defaults to this release

projectDir.description: Repo-relative project root; defaults to the MCP workspace root

replace.description: Replace an existing workflow/manifest or baseline

reportPath.description: baseline: repo-relative successful conclusive gate JSON report

target.description: baseline: application-model target id, name, or source path

name: tapp_ci
title: The merge gate in CI: preview, install, baseline
